body: Update (5 Nov, advisor review): Search offline now has its own board item, P1-16 (placed before P0-13, which depends on it). Also changed in this item after the review: ONE 'on the phone' source (onPhoneProvider, built from the downloads table) behind every Not downloaded / Plays offline; the strip's words for a silent server follow Android's own internet check (no internet found = You're offline, internet found = Can't reach your server); a tap on a song that is not downloaded says which of the two.
